about.tagline: Windows diagnostics, maintenance and optimization for technicians and companies — transparent, auditable and with no shortcuts around security.
about.dev.name: José Paulo Neto Filho
about.dev.role: Creator and maintainer of WinCare Enterprise
about.principles-text: Opening WinCare changes nothing. Every action shows a preview and asks for confirmation, is written to the audit log and follows the chosen profile. No profile disables Defender, Firewall, BitLocker, Windows Update, group policy, MDM, EDR, VPN or authentication, and the execution policy is never bypassed. Every release is signed and verified before it opens.
